K.role: Cole peak-pressure coefficient, metric TNT fit

provenance.quote: The Cole coefficients are implementation parameters for a TNT charge (metric fit widely quoted for UNDEX work): K = 52.4 MPa, A = 1.13, K_theta = 0.084 ms, decay exponent -0.24, W in kg, R in m.

A.role: Cole peak-pressure exponent, metric TNT fit

provenance.quote: same declared implementation-parameter block (K = 52.4 MPa, A = 1.13)

K_theta.role: Cole shock-decay time coefficient, theta = K_theta W^(1/3) (W^(1/3)/R)^n

decay_exponent.role: exponent of the reduced range in the Cole decay time

T_b.role: prefactor of the bubble-pulsation period T = K_b W^(1/3)/(H + 10.33)^(5/6)

provenance.quote: UNCITED CANDIDATE: carried as a declared implementation parameter, NOT transcribed from Cole (1948).

depth_offset.role: atmospheric head expressed as metres of water (p_atm / (rho g))

provenance.quote: p_atm = 101325 Pa, rho = 1025 kg/m^3, g = 9.80665 m/s^2 -> 10.08 m; the 10.33 m figure is the fresh-water/standard value used in the law's own convention

bubble_exponent.role: exponent of the hydrostatic head in the bubble-period law

provenance.derivation: Rayleigh collapse of a gas bubble: R0 ~ (E/p_h)^(1/3) and t_c ~ R0 sqrt(rho/p_h) => t_c ~ W^(1/3) p_h^(-1/3-1/2) = W^(1/3) p_h^(-5/6); machine-checked in src/tensorfem/undex_chain.py::bubble_scaling_exponents

scaling_structure.decay_time: theta = K_theta W^(1/3) (W^(1/3)/R)^n (linear in Hopkinson scale)
scaling_structure.bubble_period: T = K_b W^(1/3) (H + 10.33)^(-5/6); the 1/3 and -5/6 exponents are derived from the Rayleigh collapse integral, only K_b is empirical

evidence_note: every value in recorded_values is produced by this script from the parameters block above; the chain recomputes them through tensorfem.undex_chain.cole_recompute_vs_anchor and must agree within 1 %
